existing_models.Entry: normalEligible/enter/reserveNormal establish entry; scheduled_entry_reaches_route adds exact finite forwardAll route visitation.
existing_models.Handoff: broad and selective imply the Entry scheduling invariant; forwarding remains explicit. Neither model carries endpoint or installed animation-rule generations.
existing_models.Provider: revision-tagged provider cache/job freshness; explicitly does not model already-computed consumer/keyframe caches or installation.

new_relation.refresh: abstract changed endpoint snapshot, incrementing a per-identity generation and appending a current application job. Corresponds provisionally to KeyframeEffect::UpdateProperties changed-properties branch, mProperties assignment and RequestRestyle(Layer). Exact source is pinned; actual queue generation/snapshot representation is not claimed.
new_relation.queue: abstract FIFO request ledger for one fixed effect/target/pseudo identity. Native EffectCompositor stores coalesced target/cascade-level entries and does not store these model Version objects. A simulation relation for coalescing, selection and application is required.
new_relation.dispatch: abstract successful application at the still-current generation; stale jobs cannot overwrite newer endpoints. Native WillComposeStyle, animation-rule composition and style installation are not refined by this function.
new_relation.pass: abstract drain-before-normal-refresh ordering, motivated by StyleDocument PreTraverse plus traversal. Actual native pass ordinal and pending-queue state are not established by the earlier RFST trace.
new_relation.ready: no relevant model jobs plus current endpoints installed. Correct provider, endpoint calculation, target identity, effect lifetime and no new invalidation before the getter remain required externally.

evidence: Earlier RFST has child 64px changed=1 rebuilding after root publication, then 64px changed=0 at later target restyle while JS retains 46/46/46 before 64. This motivates separation; it does not instantiate model pass boundaries or installation transitions.
